tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere: the ledger paper the app sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas that are separate objects: a form panel, a dialog, the sign-in card.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: the file drop zone, a table's header row, a code or reference value.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between table rows and sections. Decorative, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and the drop zone: at least 3:1 on paper, surface and sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, figures and headings on paper, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and column headers on paper, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive color: primary buttons, links, the current step, the focus ring. Links read on paper, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button and link on hover or press.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover fills.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Highlight only: a marker on the row or figure that needs the reader's eye, like a tab on a columnar pad. Text on it is ink in light, paper in dark. Never a state.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Agreement and completion: an account that matches, an import that finished. Teal-blue so it never depends on a red–green difference; always with a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a look but is not wrong: a difference the accounting basis explains, an account with no type. Always with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Refusals and failures: an export that cannot be read, a difference nothing explains, a destructive action. Always with a word.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring offset 2px, on every interactive element, in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the page's headline.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings and screen titles below the headline.

styles.name: display-compact
styles.usage: The headline below bp-tablet, in place of display.

styles.name: heading-compact
styles.usage: Section headings below bp-tablet, in place of heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Choose the export QuickBooks gave you. It stays a zip; we read it here.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Text typed into an input, on every device. Never smaller: iOS Safari zooms the page into any input under 16px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, column headers, step names. Sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Accrual: income counts when you invoice, not when you're paid.
styles.usage: Help text and the one-line explanation beside an accounting term.

styles.name: money
styles.usage: Every amount in a table or list: tabular figures, right-aligned, negatives in parentheses.

styles.name: money-total
styles.usage: A total or headline figure the API computed. Tabular figures.

styles.name: money-total-compact
styles.usage: A total or headline figure below bp-tablet, in place of money-total. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label; inside a status pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its input; between related lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, vertical; button padding, vertical.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, horizontal; the phone-width page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; between form fields.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen; the desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, status pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and the drop zone.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Surfaces: panels, dialogs, the sign-in card.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus only. Everything else is separated by rules, not shadows.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Rules and control borders.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, offset 2px.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet layout from this width; below it, the phone layout.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop layout from this width. A tablet in landscape reaches it.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Content stops widening here and centers on paper.

tokens.name: columns-phone
tokens.usage: Grid columns below bp-tablet.

tokens.name: columns-tablet
tokens.usage: Grid columns from bp-tablet.

tokens.name: columns-desktop
tokens.usage: Grid columns from bp-desktop.

tokens.name: gutter-phone
tokens.usage: Page side margin and column gap below bp-tablet (space-4).

tokens.name: gutter-tablet
tokens.usage: Page side margin and column gap from bp-tablet (space-6).

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Page side margin from bp-desktop (space-10); column gap stays gutter-tablet.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: The widest the content column grows, from bp-wide.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: The widest a column of running text grows, on every device.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: The smallest a tap or click target may be, on every device, including the row actions in a table.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: The app frame's header, and the bottom action bar below bp-tablet, before safe-area insets are added.
